description: This file defines the UserDAO class, which provides data access methods for user-related database operations in a library management system.

classes.name: UserDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object class for user-related database operations in the library management system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UserDAO with a database connection object.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users along with the count of books they own.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a user record by user ID.

methods.name: getUsersByBook
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific book ID.

methods.name: getByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user record by email.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new user record to the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing user record identified by ID.
